snippet.title: Electro Bop Boxing League - Launch Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: A new and unconventional mix of Auto-Battler + Rhythm tapping challenges. Claim your mechanical fighter fame in this Atompunk / Electro Swing themed boxing game! Outfit your boxer with a variety of parts, abilities, belts and crew upgrades earned through single matches or career mode.
